conventions.units: 1 unit = 1 m, glTF Y-up, origin = ring centre = map centre
conventions.map_placement: map tile (x,y) -> world (x - w/2, 0, y - h/2): tile x runs +X (east), tile y runs +Z (south); north = -Z
conventions.yaw: bearing = atan2(-z, x) in degrees (0 = east/+X, 90 = north/-Z, 180 = west/-X, 270 = south/+Z); all files are authored for rotationY = 0 and maps are axis-aligned, so rotationY is 0 for every map
conventions.fog_rule: use glb_v5_maps/fog_valley_banks_v5_quads.glb (nodes fog_E/N/W/S, same quadrant rule) instead of glb_v5 fog_valley_banks_v5.glb; hide the per-map hide_fog_nodes (sea quadrants, all four on islands maps) so no valley fog floats over open water
conventions.node_names: near file: near_land_{Q} (+ child trees_land_{Q}_n), near_sea_{Q} (+ trees_sea_{Q}_n), water_{Q}, apron_{Q}; mid/far quad files: mid_{Q}/far_{Q} (+ trees_mid_{Q})
conventions.rule: for each quadrant show near_land_Q + apron_Q (+ mid_Q, far_Q) if land; show near_sea_Q (+ hide mid_Q, far_Q, apron_Q) if sea; water_Q shown only on sea quadrants (land near rings contain gorges below sea level that would flood); hidden on land-only maps
conventions.seams: land/land and land/sea quadrants meet on the diagonals; sea quads keep full land height on the diagonals (headlands) and carry 4 m skirts on their radial edges, so any land/sea combination closes
conventions.inner_edge: lip at y=0 on radius = class (>= corner distance + ~6 m); near outer edge 288 m meets glb_v5 mid (inner ~280 m)
conventions.tree_lod_bands_m: near-file trees: LOD0 < class+59, LOD1 < class+129, LOD2 beyond; instance json trees_near_c{R}_{S}_instances.json lists them with set/quad so the engine can hide by quadrant
conventions.fade: COLOR_0.a = aerial-fade weight ss(60,2000,R) as glb_v5

isle.note: open sea all round: islands file only (islets 400-1500 m + water_E/N/W/S); no near/mid/far rings

mires.note: open sea all round: islands file only (islets 400-1500 m + water_E/N/W/S); no near/mid/far rings

rect.note: Map-hugging near rings. Inner lip (y=0) = rounded rectangle offset 1.5 m outside the map edge, corner radius 2.5 m (map corner stays >= 1.09 m inside the lip); terrain = the radius-class ring radially re-mapped (first third compressed so slopes rise right off the border); outer edge r=288 circle meets glb_v5_maps mid/far quads as before. Node names, show/hide rule, materials, tree LOD and fade conventions identical to backdrop_near_c<R>. Use INSTEAD of maps[m].near (same mid/far/fog). apron_Q runs from 3 m inside the map edge to 1 m past the lip at y=-0.1 (land quadrants only). Sea maps also carry near_sea_Q (sea-slope segments) + water_Q.

isle.note: islands map (12E): all four quadrants are sea; ring gives sea-slope edges only (ALLSEA: no full-height corner headlands, no trees). Pair it with islands_v2 (headlands 30-80 m long / 15-40 m tall and islets 8-60 m off the coast, plus the outer skerries and water).

mires.note: islands map (12E): all four quadrants are sea; ring gives sea-slope edges only (ALLSEA: no full-height corner headlands, no trees). Pair it with islands_v2 (headlands 30-80 m long / 15-40 m tall and islets 8-60 m off the coast, plus the outer skerries and water).

border_kit.note: 12E border/coast kit: border_{peak,shelf,dune}_{a,b,c} unit pieces (1 m footprint), seacliff_{straight6,straight6b,outer,inner}_h{3,5,8}, beach_{sand,shingle}_{straight6,outer,inner}; per season
